effects.title: Sound Effects
effects.bannerDescription: Effect changes apply in real time. Try things out to reach your ideal sound!
effects.warning: Your custom adjustments are saved automatically. You can review them above.
effects.equalizerHint: Boost or cut specific frequencies for tonal balance.
effects.equalizerDescription: Adjust the gain of each band from 31 Hz to 16 kHz. The curve shows the current tonal shape.
effects.equalizerDragHint: Drag a point on the curve to adjust its band; use the arrow keys for fine control.
effects.equalizerWikiIntro: This is a 10-band peak equalizer. Each point represents a fixed center frequency and controls the gain around that band.
effects.equalizerWikiGain: Positive values boost the band; negative values cut it. The unit is dB.
effects.equalizerWikiZero: Leaves the original signal unchanged. When every point is at 0 dB, the equalizer applies no tonal gain change.
effects.equalizerWikiBands: The range runs from 31 Hz bass to 16 kHz treble. Lower frequencies sound deeper; higher frequencies sound brighter.
effects.equalizerWikiUsage: Drag the points on the curve. Raise the left bands for more bass, or lower the right bands to soften harsh treble.
effects.phaserHint: Create a spinning effect using feedback and rate.
effects.reverbHint: Add spatial depth using mix (wet/dry balance) and time.
effects.echoHint: Generate repeated delays with feedback and delay time.
effects.volumeHint: Default volume applied to every new playback channel.

wet.title: Wet
wet.description: The signal after processing by an effect.

wetDry.title: Wet/dry mix
wetDry.description: The balance between original and processed sound.

lfo.title: LFO
lfo.description: A slow oscillator that moves an effect parameter over time.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Feeds part of the effect output back into its input.

gain.title: Gain
gain.description: Level boost or attenuation, commonly measured in dB.

db.title: dB
db.description: A logarithmic level unit used by audio equipment.

hz.title: Hz
hz.description: Frequency: lower values sound deeper and higher values sound brighter.

dx8Compressor.purpose: Automatically reduces peaks so the overall level becomes more consistent.
dx8Compressor.quickStart: Start with Threshold, set Ratio for the amount of control, then use Gain to restore level. Adjust Attack and Release to preserve the groove.

bassFxCompressor2.purpose: A BASS_FX compressor with a wider timing range and channel selection.
bassFxCompressor2.quickStart: Use Threshold and Ratio first; use Attack and Release to decide how much of the transient and tail remain.

bassFxDamp.purpose: Automatically lifts quiet material toward a target while limiting how quickly it rises.
bassFxDamp.quickStart: Set Quiet to detect low passages, Target to the desired level, and Rate to control how fast the correction moves.

volume.purpose: A volume transition effect intended for fades and smooth level changes.
volume.quickStart: Set Target and Time; choose a curve when a linear fade does not sound natural.

bassFxVolume.purpose: A direct linear volume multiplier that can target a specific channel.
bassFxVolume.quickStart: 1.0 leaves the signal unchanged, 0.5 halves it, and values above 1 amplify it.

volumeEnvelope.purpose: Automates volume along a timeline using editable control points.
volumeEnvelope.quickStart: Use a first node at position 0; for a three-second fade-in use (0, 0) and (3, 1).

dx8Reverb.purpose: A basic room-like reverb that adds reflections and a decaying tail.
dx8Reverb.quickStart: ReverbTime controls room size; ReverbMix controls how prominent the tail is.

dx8I3dl2Reverb.purpose: A detailed room model based on the Interactive 3D Audio Level 2 reverb standard.
dx8I3dl2Reverb.quickStart: Most users only need Room, DecayTime and the reverb level; leave the remaining acoustic controls at their defaults first.

freeverb.purpose: An efficient, natural-sounding Freeverb algorithm for real-time room ambience.
freeverb.quickStart: RoomSize and Damp are the main controls: larger rooms sound wider, while more damping makes the tail darker.

dx8Echo.purpose: A classic stereo echo with separate left and right delay times.
dx8Echo.quickStart: Set the delay first, then raise Feedback for more repeats. Enable PanDelay for a ping-pong movement.

bassFxEcho.purpose: A compact BASS_FX echo controlled by level and delay time.
bassFxEcho.quickStart: Use Level for the repeat strength and Delay for the spacing between repeats.

bassFxEcho2.purpose: A dry/wet BASS_FX echo with feedback and channel routing.
bassFxEcho2.quickStart: Balance DryMix and WetMix first, then add Feedback for repeated echoes.

bassFxEcho3.purpose: A simple BASS_FX delay with dry/wet mix and channel routing.
bassFxEcho3.quickStart: Use Delay to set the repeat spacing and WetMix to blend it into the source.

bassFxEcho4.purpose: A flexible delay with independent dry/wet levels and optional stereo interleaving.
bassFxEcho4.quickStart: Delay is measured in seconds here: 0.20 means 200 ms. Feedback around 0.5 creates repeated echoes.

dx8Chorus.purpose: Layers a slightly detuned delayed copy to make a sound thicker and wider.
dx8Chorus.quickStart: Depth controls movement, Frequency controls its speed, and Delay should remain short.

dx8Flanger.purpose: Uses a very short modulated delay and feedback for a sweeping jet-like sound.
dx8Flanger.quickStart: Keep Delay short; negative Feedback and a slow Frequency create the classic hollow sweep.

bassFxFlanger.purpose: A compact BASS_FX flanger with wet/dry blend, speed and channel routing.
bassFxFlanger.quickStart: Increase Speed slowly and blend the effect with WetDry to avoid an overpowering sweep.

bassFxChorus.purpose: A linear-value BASS_FX chorus with explicit sweep limits and channel routing.
bassFxChorus.quickStart: The distance between MinSweep and MaxSweep controls sweep width; Rate controls how quickly it moves.

phaser.purpose: Moves spectral notches to create a spacious, psychedelic motion.
phaser.quickStart: Raise Range for a wider sweep; Feedback emphasizes the resonant peaks.

autowah.purpose: Sweeps a resonant filter to create an automatic wah-wah motion.
autowah.quickStart: Freq sets the starting point, Range sets the span, and Rate sets the sweep speed.

gargle.purpose: Modulates volume with a selectable waveform, from a smooth pulse to a hard gate.
gargle.quickStart: Use a low Rate for audible tremolo; choose the square wave for a sharper on/off effect.

rotate.purpose: Rotates the signal between channels to create a spinning stereo image.
rotate.quickStart: The sign of Rate selects the rotation direction; reduce it for a slower, subtler movement.

bassFxReverb.purpose: A lightweight BASS_FX reverb with level and delay controls.
bassFxReverb.quickStart: Raise Level for more ambience and use Delay to separate the early response from the source.

lowpassFilter.purpose: A resonant low-pass filter that removes high frequencies above its cutoff.
lowpassFilter.quickStart: Lower CutOffFreq to darken the sound; add Resonance for a focused peak near the cutoff.

allpassFilter.purpose: An all-pass filter that changes phase and delay without directly removing a frequency range.
allpassFilter.quickStart: Use small Gain and Delay changes for subtle phase shaping; stronger settings create coloration.

bassFxCompressor.purpose: A simple BASS_FX compressor with threshold, attack, release and channel routing.
bassFxCompressor.quickStart: Lower Threshold until compression begins, then tune Attack and Release to match the rhythm.

dx8Distortion.purpose: Adds harmonic saturation by shaping the waveform and filtering the result.
dx8Distortion.quickStart: Edge controls clipping intensity; use the post-EQ and pre-low-pass controls to tame harshness.

bassFxDistortion.purpose: A flexible saturator with drive, dry/wet mix, feedback and output level.
bassFxDistortion.quickStart: Increase Drive gradually, balance DryMix/WetMix, then use Volume to match the bypassed level.

dx8Parameq.purpose: Boosts or cuts a selected frequency band for tonal balance.
dx8Parameq.quickStart: Choose Center, set Bandwidth for the affected range, then adjust Gain sparingly.

bassFxPeakeq.purpose: A multi-band peak equalizer with selectable band and channel routing.
bassFxPeakeq.quickStart: Set Center and Gain; use either Bandwidth or Q to control how narrow the change is.

biquadFilter.purpose: Provides low-pass, high-pass, shelving, peaking and other biquad filter shapes.
biquadFilter.quickStart: Choose Filter first, then tune Center and either Bandwidth or Q. Gain is used by selected EQ and shelf modes.

pitchshift.purpose: Changes pitch independently from tempo using real-time spectral processing.
pitchshift.quickStart: Use PitchShift for a ratio or Semitones for musical steps; larger FFT sizes improve quality at the cost of latency.

mix.purpose: Maps input channels to output channels for custom routing and channel mixing.
mix.quickStart: Use the channel map to select which input feeds each output; -1 keeps the default routing.

effects.playbackWiki: These controls are applied to the playback channel.
effects.volumeWiki: Output level from 0 to 100 percent. Mute remains a temporary session state.
effects.speedWiki: Tempo offset in percent. 0% is the original speed; negative values slow playback.
effects.reverseWiki: Plays the track in the opposite direction through the decoded audio stream.
effects.frequencyWiki: Playback sample-rate multiplier. It changes frequency and may also change pitch.
effects.panWiki: Stereo position from full left to full right.

categoryDescriptions.chorus: Chorus layers short, slightly detuned copies of the signal to create width and movement.
categoryDescriptions.compressor: Compression reduces dynamic range: quiet parts become more consistent while peaks are controlled.
categoryDescriptions.distortion: Distortion adds harmonic saturation by reshaping the waveform. Increase drive carefully.
categoryDescriptions.echo: Echo and delay repeat the signal after a time interval. Dry/wet mix controls the balance with the original.
categoryDescriptions.flanger: Flanger mixes a very short modulated delay with the source to produce a sweeping comb-filter sound.
categoryDescriptions.reverb: Reverb simulates reflections in a space. Room, decay, damping and mix determine the character.
categoryDescriptions.equalizer: Equalizers adjust selected frequency bands without changing the rest of the signal equally.
categoryDescriptions.filters: Filters remove or reshape frequency ranges. Cutoff, resonance and filter type define the result.
categoryDescriptions.volumeFx: Volume effects automate level over time or route a channel-specific volume change.
categoryDescriptions.pitchshift: Pitch shifting changes pitch independently from the tempo by using a real-time spectral process.
categoryDescriptions.modulation: Modulation effects periodically change delay, phase or amplitude to create movement and texture.
categoryDescriptions.channel: Channel routing effects mix or redirect the left and right channels.
categoryDescriptions.dynamics: Dynamic effects reshape level response, including damping and envelope behavior.

effects.playbackDescription: These controls affect the current playback channel and are saved as defaults for the next track.
effects.speedHint: Change playback speed; 0% is the original rate.
effects.frequencyHint: Adjust playback frequency relative to the source sample rate.
effects.panHint: Place the sound between the left and right channels.
effects.dx8Education: DX8 is the Windows DirectX 8 audio effect family. It is useful for native system effects, but its algorithms and parameters are not identical to BASS_FX.
effects.bassFxEducation: BASS_FX is the official BASS extension library, providing real-time filters, delays, reverbs, compressors, pitch shifting and more.

parameterDescriptions.fWetDryMix: Balance between original and processed sound.
parameterDescriptions.fFeedback: Amount of output fed back into the effect.
parameterDescriptions.fDelay: Time before a repeat or reflection appears.
parameterDescriptions.lPhase: Phase offset between channel modulation waves.
parameterDescriptions.fGain: Output or band gain, usually in dB.
parameterDescriptions.fAttack: Time for the effect to fully respond to a peak.
parameterDescriptions.fRelease: Time for the effect to recover after a peak.
parameterDescriptions.fPredelay: Extra time used to preserve the transient before processing.
parameterDescriptions.dwRateHz: Speed of volume or modulation movement.
parameterDescriptions.flDecayTime: Time for the reverb tail to decay.
parameterDescriptions.flDecayHFRatio: High-frequency decay relative to low frequency.
parameterDescriptions.flReflectionsDelay: Time from direct sound to the first reflection.
parameterDescriptions.flReverbDelay: Gap between early reflections and late reverb.
parameterDescriptions.flDiffusion: Smoothness and density of late reverb.
parameterDescriptions.flDensity: Modal density and grain of the reverb tail.
parameterDescriptions.flHFReference: Frequency used as the high-frequency reference.
parameterDescriptions.fCenter: Center frequency of the affected band.
parameterDescriptions.fBandwidth: Width of the affected frequency band.
parameterDescriptions.fTarget: Target level for automatic volume control.
parameterDescriptions.fCurrent: Current level; -1 commonly means keep the current value.
parameterDescriptions.fTime: Time to move from current to target level.
parameterDescriptions.lChannel: Target channel; -1 commonly means all channels.
parameterDescriptions.fWetDry: Linear blend between original and processed sound.
parameterDescriptions.fQ: Quality factor; higher values make a narrower band.
parameterDescriptions.fResonance: Resonance boost near the cutoff frequency.
parameterDescriptions.fCutOffFreq: Frequency at which the filter starts attenuating.
parameterDescriptions.fQuiet: Level considered quiet enough to trigger gain.
parameterDescriptions.fRange: Frequency span covered by a sweep or modulation.
parameterDescriptions.fFreq: Starting frequency for a sweep or auto-filter.
parameterDescriptions.fAttacktime: Time for a dynamics effect to engage.
parameterDescriptions.fReleasetime: Time for a dynamics effect to release.
parameterDescriptions.pNodes: Envelope nodes containing position and level.
parameterDescriptions.bFollow: Whether the envelope follows the current playback position.
parameterDescriptions.bStereo: Whether left and right channels are processed independently.
parameterDescriptions.lFFTsize: Spectral analysis frame size; larger means better resolution and more latency.
parameterDescriptions.lOsamp: Oversampling factor; higher values improve quality and CPU cost.
parameterDescriptions.fDamp: High-frequency damping; higher values darken the tail.
parameterDescriptions.lMode: Effect mode, such as normal or frozen tail.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoAlbumTheme: Pick theme color automatically from album cover
settings.frameRateHint: A higher frame rate gives smoother visuals but costs more performance.
settings.gpuModeRestartHint: Changing this recreates the WebGL context; it only affects the flowing background's rendering preference.
settings.webglDiagnosticsHint: Shows the WebGL renderer used by the current WebView. SwiftShader indicates software rendering.
settings.languageHint: Interface display language. Language files are JSON files in the i18n folder next to the executable; the file name is the language code.
settings.dataDirHint: Playlists, the music library database, covers and network cache are stored here. Changing the directory switches the entire library (multi-library).
settings.dataDirRestartHint: A restart is required for the data directory change to take effect.
settings.dataDirRestartNotice: Data directory changed. Please restart the app to apply.
